title: TEECheck RepoFacts v1
description: The deterministic whole-repo program index. It answers what structure was observed, never what is dangerous: no field here may carry a priority, a risk label or a TWE mapping. See docs/bugs/BUG-003 for the amplification chain that follows when 01 pre-judges.

index_note.description: Why a capability is degraded. A reader must be able to tell a repository with no indirect calls from an extractor that could not run.

unresolved_call_site_count.description: The multiplicity. Not the length of unresolved_call_sites: a CodeQL result is a set, so two calls on one line with the same expression collapse into one row.

external_call_sites.description: Calls to a function with no definition in this tree. They produce no call edge, and are one reason a function can show no callers while being called.

ambiguous_call_sites.description: Calls to a function defined several times, where which definition links is not decidable from the source. Emitting one edge would be a fabrication and emitting all would claim every implementation is called, so they produce none.

capabilities.description: Reported per capability rather than as one verdict: under --build-mode=none the symbol table is solid while build reachability was never computed, and a single word cannot say which.

functionCapsule.description: One function's neutral behaviour record. additionalProperties is false so a judgement field cannot be added without changing this contract: that is what makes the no-verdict rule a cross-stage guarantee rather than a Go-only test.

field_accesses.description: Every Type.field touched, read or written. Not named reads: CodeQL's FieldAccess matches an assignment's left-hand side too.

direct_field_writes.description: The subset provable as a direct assignment. A field filled by memcpy, through a pointer alias, or by a designated initializer is absent, and its absence proves nothing.

unresolvedCall.description: One call site whose target the extractor could not name. A total count cannot answer whether anything unresolved reaches a given function, so the enclosing symbol and the expression are required to make a missing caller interpretable.

resolution_kind.description: Only what the query can prove. An ExprCall dispatches through an expression, which is provable from the call's shape; anything else with no target is unknown, because a macro-expanded call and a call to an undeclared function are indistinguishable here.
